text_en: Then Isaac called Jacob and blessed him, and charged him, “You shall not marry one of the Canaanite women.
text_cn: 依撒格叫了雅各伯来，祝福他，吩咐他说：“你不要娶客纳罕女人为妻。

text_en: Go at once to Paddan-aram to the house of Bethuel, your mother’s father; and take as wife from there one of the daughters of Laban, your mother’s brother.
text_cn: 你应起身往帕丹阿兰你外祖父贝突耳家去，在那里娶你舅父拉班的女儿为妻。

text_en: May God Almighty bless you and make you fruitful and numerous, that you may become a company of peoples.
text_cn: 愿全能的天主祝福你，使你生育繁殖，成为一大家族。

text_en: May he give to you the blessing of Abraham, to you and to your offspring with you, so that you may take possession of the land where you now live as an alien—land that God gave to Abraham. ”
text_cn: 愿天主将亚巴郎的祝福赐与你和你的后裔，使你承受你所住的地方，即天主赐与亚巴郎的土地作为产业。”

text_en: Thus Isaac sent Jacob away; and he went to Paddan-aram, to Laban son of Bethuel the Aramean, the brother of Rebekah, Jacob’s and Esau’s mother.
text_cn: 依撒格就这样打发了雅各伯往帕丹阿兰，投往阿兰人贝突耳的儿子拉班，即雅各伯和厄撒乌的母亲黎贝加的哥哥那里去了。

text_en: Now Esau saw that Isaac had blessed Jacob and sent him away to Paddan-aram to take a wife from there, and that as he blessed him he charged him, “You shall not marry one of the Canaanite women, ”
text_cn: 厄撒乌见依撒格祝福了雅各伯，打发他到帕丹阿兰去，在那里娶妻；祝福他时还吩咐他说：“不要娶客纳罕女人为妻。”

text_en: and that Jacob had obeyed his father and his mother and gone to Paddan-aram.
text_cn: 厄撒乌见雅各伯听从父母的命，往帕丹阿兰去了，

text_en: So when Esau saw that the Canaanite women did not please his father Isaac,
text_cn: 便明白父亲依撒格不喜欢客纳罕女子。

text_en: Esau went to Ishmael and took Mahalath daughter of Abraham’s son Ishmael, and sister of Nebaioth, to be his wife in addition to the wives he had.
text_cn: 所以他去了依市玛耳那里，除自己所有的两个妻子外，又娶了亚巴郎之子依市玛耳的女儿乃巴约特的妹妹玛哈拉特为妻。

text_en: Jacob left Beer-sheba and went toward Haran.
text_cn: 雅各伯离开贝尔舍巴，往哈兰去了。

text_en: He came to a certain place and stayed there for the night, because the sun had set. Taking one of the stones of the place, he put it under his head and lay down in that place.
text_cn: 他来到一个地方，因太阳已落，就在那里过宿，随地拿了一块石头，放在头底下，就在那地方躺下睡了。

text_en: And he dreamed that there was a ladder set up on the earth, the top of it reaching to heaven; and the angels of God were ascending and descending on it.
text_cn: 他作了一梦：见一个梯子直立在地上，梯顶与天相接；天主的使者在梯子上，上去下来。

text_en: And the Lord stood beside him and said, “I am the Lord , the God of Abraham your father and the God of Isaac; the land on which you lie I will give to you and to your offspring;
text_cn: 上主立在梯子上说：“我是上主，你父亚巴郎的天主，依撒格的天主。我要将你所躺的地方，赐给你和你的后裔。

text_en: and your offspring shall be like the dust of the earth, and you shall spread abroad to the west and to the east and to the north and to the south; and all the families of the earth shall be blessed in you and in your offspring.
text_cn: 你的后裔要多得如地上的灰尘；你要向东西南北扩展，地上的万民都要因你和你的后裔蒙受祝福。

text_en: Know that I am with you and will keep you wherever you go, and will bring you back to this land; for I will not leave you until I have done what I have promised you. ”
text_cn: 看我与你同在；你不论到哪里，我必护佑你，领你回到此地。我决不离弃你，直到我实践了我对你所许的。”

text_en: Then Jacob woke from his sleep and said, “Surely the Lord is in this place—and I did not know it! ”
text_cn: 雅各伯一觉醒来，说：“上主实在在这地方，我竟不知道。”

text_en: And he was afraid, and said, “How awesome is this place! This is none other than the house of God, and this is the gate of heaven. ”
text_cn: 他又满怀敬畏地说：“这地方多么可畏！这里不是别处，乃是天主的住所，上天之门。”

text_en: So Jacob rose early in the morning, and he took the stone that he had put under his head and set it up for a pillar and poured oil on the top of it.
text_cn: 雅各伯清早一起来，就把那块放在头底下的石头，立作石柱，在顶上倒了油，

text_en: He called that place Bethel; but the name of the city was Luz at the first.
text_cn: 给那地方起名叫贝特耳，原先那城名叫路次。

text_en: Then Jacob made a vow, saying, “If God will be with me, and will keep me in this way that I go, and will give me bread to eat and clothing to wear,
text_cn: 然后雅各伯许愿说：“若是天主与我同在，在我所走的路上护佑我，赐我丰衣足食，

text_en: so that I come again to my father’s house in peace, then the Lord shall be my God,
text_cn: 使我平安回到父家，上主实在当是我的天主。

text_en: and this stone, which I have set up for a pillar, shall be God’s house; and of all that you give me I will surely give one-tenth to you. ”
text_cn: 我立作石柱的这块石头，必要成为天主的住所；凡你赐与我的，我必给你奉献十分之一。”
